Meta.title: Amsel — Kitchen in Vienna
Meta.description: Amsel: a kitchen in Vienna-Margareten that follows the season instead of a fixed menu. The Season Line shows what's actually growing.

Home.headline: Where the city goes quiet.
Home.subtitle: What ripens today reaches the table today — Amsel cooks from what the market and the garden give up right now.
Home.heroImageLabel: Hero — kitchen at dusk, chef at the pass

manifesto.quote: We cook what's growing this week — not what's always on the menu.
manifesto.body: Amsel works without a fixed year-round menu. What comes from the ground, the cellar or a nearby market decides what lands on the plate — the Season Line shows exactly that, month by month.
manifesto.imageLabel: Detail — ingredient on the cutting board

seasonTeaser.title: The Season Line
seasonTeaser.body: Instead of a fixed menu: a timeline through the year. Drag, scroll or use the arrow keys through the months — and see what's actually growing.

Haus.metaDescription: About Amsel: kitchen, space, and how to request a table.
Haus.title: The House
Haus.intro: Amsel sits in a former courtyard building in Vienna-Margareten — stone floors, tall windows, a tiled stove that still burns real wood.
Haus.philosophyBody: We work with a fixed circle of small producers around Vienna — what they deliver decides the menu, not the other way round. No dish stays on the menu longer than it's actually in season.
Haus.detailImageLabel: Detail — tools and ingredient in the kitchen
